findings.finding: Закрыть уведомление: sibling “Dismiss … notice” labels (ui.browser.browser_passkey_notice.dismiss, ui.browser.browser_file_transfer_row.dismiss_download_notice/_upload_notice, ui.common.updates.update_quiet_indicator.dismiss_update_notice, ui.settings.configuration…dismiss_this_notice) all use Скрыть (Скрыть уведомление о ключе доступа, …); Закрыть matches this band's prompt_dismiss and is idiomatic for an icon close button. Accessible name only. No change.

«Системные настройки › Конфиденциальность и безопасность» equals the audited media_permission hint (ёлочки per guide); gender/number agreement correct in every arm (заблокирован/-а/-ы, выключен/-а/-ы); «Разрешить» quoted like agent_tab_hint.

Round-2 remediation (748f4c83caf) made blocked_hint a devices select, resolving the a2 source observation (“them” for one device); the component now passes devices (browser-media-permission-prompt.tsx:152). его (микрофон, м.р.) / её (камера, ж.р.; ё as elsewhere in the ru corpus, e.g. придётся in system_blocked_hint) / их (both) agree in every arm.

The other 8 keys are byte-identical to the values audited as mp1843-a2-ru at 99d69f364e3 (JSON key-by-key compare of git show 99d69f364e3: vs 748f4c83caf:; only blocked_hint differs in en, context and this locale); a2 verdicts on them are carried, re-run mechanically here.
